goal: Prevent saved fee estimates from falling behind the chain tip during shutdown
Ensure the mempool can reuse persisted fee statistics on node restart
agreement: Broad support with no objections to the fix (maflcko, ismaelsadeeq, davidgumberg, w0xlt)
Views it as a minor local shutdown bug not needing responsible disclosure (maflcko)
Nonblocking suggestion to expand tests demonstrating missed notification effects (ismaelsadeeq)
Nonblocking suggestion to clarify shutdown callback comments (davidgumberg)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes an edge-case shutdown ordering bug that discards valid fee data on restart
Prevents the mempool estimator from ignoring its saved file if callbacks remain queued at exit
